title: Champion Services Sector
definition: The 'Champion Services Sectors' initiative was launched by the Government of India under the Department of Commerce (Ministry of Commerce and Industry) to focus on 12 identified key service sectors with high export potential, employment generation capacities, and global competitiveness.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (economic schemes, service sector trade data) and Mains GS Paper 3 (Indian Economy, growth, employment, export diversification, and services-led development model).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Champion Services Sectors.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
